definitions: A 1969 American drama film, directed by John Schlesinger, about a naive hustler from Texas who moves to New York City.
A person resembling the main character of the film 'Midnight Cowboy', often implying a male prostitute or a naive person trying to make it in a big city.
examples: He watched Midnight Cowboy for the first time last night.
Some people refer to him as a Midnight Cowboy, always looking for his next score.
